description: MainActivity class for an Android TicTacToe app implementation, managing UI interactions, game state rendering, and accessibility features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Activity managing the main UI for the TicTacToe game, handling user interaction, game state rendering, and accessibility announcements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, and configures click listeners.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves game state to preserve it during configuration changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI elements to reflect the current game state.

methods.name: showResultSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar message with an option to reset the game.

methods.name: cellContentDescription
methods.description: Generates accompanying accessibility descriptions for each cell.

methods.name: maybeAnnounceEndState
methods.description: Ensures end-of-game announcements are made only once per game result.

methods.name: announceForAccessibility
methods.description: Performs accessibility announcements using the root view.
